name: Important Windows Eventlog Cleared
description: Detects the clearing of one of the Windows Core Eventlogs. e.g. caused by "wevtutil cl" command execution
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Rollout of log collection agents (the setup routine often includes a reset of the local Eventlog)
System provisioning (system reset before the golden image creation)
query: winlog.channel:System AND (event.code:104 AND winlog.provider_name:Microsoft\-Windows\-Eventlog AND (winlog.channel:(Microsoft\-Windows\-PowerShell\/Operational OR Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational OR PowerShellCore\/Operational OR Security OR System OR Windows\ PowerShell)))
